h1: HubSpot Marketing & Sales Hub Pricing Calculator: Core Seats, Contact-Tier Cliffs & Mandatory Onboarding Fees (2026)
summary: HubSpot's 2026 Seat-Based Pricing Model splits users into Free View-Only Seats, Paid Core Seats ($15 Starter / $45–$50 Pro / $75 Enterprise per seat/month), and specialized Sales/Service Seats ($90–$100 Pro / $150 Enterprise)—plus automatic marketing contact tier escalators ($225–$250 per 5,000 contacts) and mandatory $1,500–$7,000 Professional/Enterprise onboarding fees.

auditNotes: View-Only Seat Reclassification: Executives and finance reviewers who only inspect dashboards should be assigned Free View-Only Seats rather than $45–$75/mo Core Seats or $90–$150/mo Sales Seats.
Non-Reversible Contact Tier Ratchet: In HubSpot Marketing Hub, crossing a marketing contact threshold mid-month ratchets your billing tier upward for the rest of your annual commitment term.

faq.q: What is the difference between a HubSpot Core Seat and a Sales Seat in 2026?
faq.a: A Paid Core Seat ($15 Starter, $45–$50 Professional, $75 Enterprise) grants edit access to the Smart CRM and Marketing/Content/Operations tools, whereas a Sales Seat ($90–$100 Pro, $150 Enterprise) is required for sequences, playbooks, deal rotation, and custom sales forecasting.

faq.q: Can you waive HubSpot's $1,500 to $3,000 Professional onboarding fee?
faq.a: Yes. Working through a certified HubSpot Solutions Partner or demonstrating prior HubSpot admin certification during contract negotiation frequently waives the $1,500 Sales Pro or $3,000 Marketing Pro onboarding fee.

faq.q: How do I stop paying for non-revenue contacts in HubSpot Marketing Hub?
faq.a: Designate bounced, unsubscribed, internal employee, and sales-only CRM records as 'Non-Marketing Contacts' prior to your monthly billing evaluation date; HubSpot stores up to 15 million non-marketing contacts at $0.

faq.q: How does SSO/SCIM provisioning cut wasted CRM and SaaS seat spend?
faq.a: Connecting your HRIS/IdP (such as Rippling IT or Okta) automatically revokes paid HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoom, and Slack seats on the exact day an employee departs, cutting 12%–18% in zombie seat renewals.
